sql_model.form_descr: Book, approve, invoice and record payment for banner slots

validations.name: Advertiser type is a listed value
validations.message: Advertiser type must be M, T or E.

column.name: unit_no
column.heading: Unit No
column.descr: Unit of the advertiser (mandatory for Member and Tenant)

validations.name: Unit exists
validations.message: Unit not found in Unit Master.

column.name: banner_image
column.heading: Banner Image
column.descr: Banner image (see the plan's image size guidance)

column.name: click_url
column.heading: Click URL
column.descr: Web address opened when the banner is clicked

validations.name: Valid web address
validations.message: Click URL must be a valid web address starting with http:// or https://.

column.name: start_date
column.heading: Start Date
column.descr: First day of the banner period (not in the past)

column.name: no_of_months
column.heading: No of Months
column.descr: Whole number of months, at least the plan's minimum

validations.name: Whole number of months
validations.message: No of months must be a whole number of at least 1.

validations.name: At least plan minimum
validations.message: No of months is below the minimum months of the active rate plan.

builtin.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN {form.no_of_months} >= MIN_MONTHS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM CCW_BANNER_RATE_PLAN_MASTER WHERE STATUS = 'A'

column.name: end_date
column.heading: End Date
column.descr: Calculated: start date + no of months - 1 day
column.sql_expression: CAST({CCW_BANNER_BOOKING}.start_date + CAST({CCW_BANNER_BOOKING}.no_of_months AS integer) * INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day' AS DATE)

column.name: display_state
column.heading: Display State
column.descr: Derived: Live only when Approved, Paid and today is within start/end; Scheduled before start; Ended after end
column.sql_expression: CASE WHEN {CCW_BANNER_BOOKING}.booking_status <> 'A' THEN NULL WHEN CURRENT_DATE > CAST({CCW_BANNER_BOOKING}.start_date + CAST({CCW_BANNER_BOOKING}.no_of_months AS integer) * INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day' AS DATE) THEN 'Ended' WHEN CURRENT_DATE < {CCW_BANNER_BOOKING}.start_date THEN 'Scheduled' WHEN {CCW_BANNER_BOOKING}.payment_status = 'P' THEN 'Live' ELSE 'Scheduled' END

column.name: booking_status
column.heading: Booking Status
column.descr: Requested / Approved / Rejected / Cancelled; changed by actions

column.name: rate_per_month
column.heading: Rate per Month
column.descr: Defaults from the Active Banner Rate Plan (RATE_PER_SLOT_PER_MONTH)

column.name: tax_pct
column.heading: Tax %
column.descr: From the Active Banner Rate Plan

column.name: payment_status
column.heading: Payment Status
column.descr: Unpaid / Paid; set by Record Payment

validations.name: Payment Mode is a listed value
validations.message: Payment Mode must be one of: C, Q, B, U

column.name: received_by
column.heading: Received By
column.descr: Management user who received the payment

column.name: add_user
column.heading: Added By
column.descr: Audit: added by (also scopes member/tenant visibility)

validations.name: Unit needed for Member/Tenant
validations.message: Unit No is mandatory for Member and Tenant advertisers.

validations.name: Start date not in the past
validations.message: Start date cannot be in the past.

validations.name: Edit rules after approval
validations.message: After approval only the payment fields can be edited.

business_logic.spec: Only when _action = 'edit': read the stored CCW_BANNER_BOOKING row for BOOKING_NO. If stored BOOKING_STATUS <> 'R', return an error when any of ADVERTISER_TYPE, UNIT_NO, ADVERTISER_NAME, CONTACT_NO, EMAIL, BANNER_TITLE, BANNER_IMAGE, CLICK_URL, START_DATE, NO_OF_MONTHS, RATE_PER_MONTH, AMOUNT, TAX_PCT, TAX_AMOUNT, TOTAL_AMOUNT differs from the stored value ('After approval only the payment fields can be edited'). If stored BOOKING_STATUS is not 'A' or PAYMENT_STATUS = 'P', also refuse changes to PAYMENT_MODE, PAYMENT_REFERENCE, PAYMENT_DATE, RECEIVED_BY. Also refuse any change to BOOKING_STATUS, PAYMENT_STATUS, INVOICE_NO, INVOICE_DATE, REJECTION_REASON through the form (they change only through actions). Return None when valid.

validations.name: Requested only
validations.message: Only Requested bookings can be deleted.

business_logic.description: Approve the booking, check capacity and generate the invoice
business_logic.spec: Management only. Refuse unless BOOKING_STATUS='R'. Compute the period: START_DATE to END_DATE = START_DATE + NO_OF_MONTHS months - 1 day. Read MAX_CAROUSEL_SLOTS from the Active plan in CCW_BANNER_RATE_PLAN_MASTER (STATUS='A'; error if none). For every day D of the period count CCW_BANNER_BOOKING rows with BOOKING_STATUS='A' whose own period (start_date to start_date + no_of_months months - 1 day) covers D; the booked count must stay below MAX_CAROUSEL_SLOTS on every day (i.e. existing approved count + this booking <= MAX_CAROUSEL_SLOTS). If any day is full, block approval with an error stating the next available start date: the first date on/after START_DATE from which a period of NO_OF_MONTHS months has fewer approved bookings than MAX_CAROUSEL_SLOTS on every day. On success set BOOKING_STATUS='A', generate a unique INVOICE_NO (e.g. 'BNR/' + financial year + '/' + zero-padded running serial) and INVOICE_DATE = today, then email the advertiser (EMAIL) the invoice details (invoice no, date, period, amount, tax, total). Return {"message":"Booking approved; invoice <INVOICE_NO> raised"}.

validations.name: Must be Requested
validations.message: Only Requested bookings can be approved.

confirmation.message: Approve booking {form.booking_no} and raise the invoice?

business_logic.spec: Management only. Refuse unless BOOKING_STATUS='R'. Require a non-blank REJECTION_REASON from the payload. Set BOOKING_STATUS='J' and store REJECTION_REASON on CCW_BANNER_BOOKING; notify the advertiser (EMAIL) with the reason. Return {"message":"Booking rejected"}.

validations.name: Must be Requested
validations.message: Only Requested bookings can be rejected.

business_logic.description: Cancel the booking before its start date
business_logic.spec: Allowed for the booking's owner (ADD_USER) or management. Refuse unless BOOKING_STATUS is 'R' or 'A' and START_DATE is after today ('Cancel is allowed before the start date'). Set BOOKING_STATUS='C'. Refunds are settled outside the system; if PAYMENT_STATUS='P' include that note in the returned message. Return {"message":"Booking cancelled"}.

validations.name: Requested or Approved
validations.message: Only Requested or Approved bookings can be cancelled.

validations.name: Before start date
validations.message: A booking can be cancelled only before its start date.

business_logic.description: Record payment and make the banner eligible for the carousel
business_logic.spec: Management only. Refuse unless BOOKING_STATUS='A' and PAYMENT_STATUS='U' ('A booking can be recorded as Paid only after Approval'). Require PAYMENT_MODE, PAYMENT_REFERENCE and PAYMENT_DATE (not in the future) on the saved record; default RECEIVED_BY to the signed-in user's email when blank. Set PAYMENT_STATUS='P' on CCW_BANNER_BOOKING. The banner is then eligible for the carousel (Live when today is within START_DATE..END_DATE). Notify the advertiser (EMAIL) that payment was received. Return {"message":"Payment recorded"}.

validations.name: Must be Approved
validations.message: Payment can be recorded only after approval.

validations.name: Payment details entered
validations.message: Enter payment mode, reference and date (and save) before recording payment.

validations.name: Invoice raised
validations.message: The invoice is available only after approval.
